draft_key_information_units.information: Headline financial performance showing revenue of EUR 118.7 million (-0.8%), adjusted EBITDA of EUR 56.5 million (+6%), profit of EUR 22.5 million (+17%), and investments of EUR 33.2 million (-14%), with improved equity position and reduced net debt.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Section 5.1 Key performance indicators table and surrounding text; Consolidated Financial Statements

draft_key_information_units.information: Passenger business growth with 8.3 million passengers (+1.0% YoY), dominated by Tallinn-Helsinki route (+1% passengers), and cruise tourism recovery featuring 190 thousand cruise passengers (+25%) and 118 calls (+18), offset by Tallinn-Stockholm decline.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Sections 5.4 Market overview: passengers and 5.6.1 Number of passengers

draft_key_information_units.information: Cargo volume recovery to 13.8 million tonnes (+5.1% YoY) driven by liquid bulk surge (+47%, led by ligroin and gasoline), transit goods growth (+75%), and dry bulk increase, partially offset by ro-ro and container declines.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Sections 5.5 Market overview: cargo and 5.6.2 Cargo volume

draft_key_information_units.information: Major strategic infrastructure investments including completion of multifunctional quay at Paldiski South Harbour, Muuga Harbour quay reinforcement for large vessels, and ongoing design work for Old City Harbour Terminal A and shore power capacity.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Section 5.10 Investments and development prospects

draft_key_information_units.information: Dividend distribution of EUR 19.199 million (EUR 0.073 per share) representing 100% of prior year profit, aligned with policy, accompanied by share price appreciation to EUR 1.296 (+22.7%).
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Sections 5.11 Dividends and 5.12 Share and shareholders

draft_key_information_units.information: Adverse impact of Russia-Ukraine war reducing liquid bulk volumes and eliminating St. Petersburg cruise calls, partially mitigated by winter cruise season extension, regional marketing, and economic recovery in Estonia and Nordic partners.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Sections 5.2 Economic environment and 5.3 Impact of Russia-Ukraine war

draft_key_information_units.information: Icebreaker Botnica operated at reduced utilization rate (49%) with lower charter revenue, but participated in international rescue operations for cargo ship MV Thamesborg in Canadian Arctic waters.

Environmental sustainability progress including 77% renewable energy usage in operations, GHG emissions reduction of 11% YoY to 19,261 tonnes CO2e, and initiatives for shore power and waste circularity at Old City Harbour.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Section 3 Environment and CEO letter (Section 1.4)

evaluation.selection_rationale: Units prioritized reflect headline financial performance (D1), major business-line recoveries in passengers (D2) and cargo (D3), strategic infrastructure development (D4), shareholder returns (D5), and material external impacts (D6). D7 covers a key operational highlight for the Other segment, while D8 addresses sustainability achievements. Excluded routine boilerplate (governance, remuneration, risk lists) per guidance. Each unit represents an independently omittable material theme central to understanding financial performance, drivers, liquidity, and strategy. REFERENCE SUMMARY validated salience for D1-D7; D8, while material per SOURCE, extends beyond the REFERENCE example's explicit coverage.
